# Lebanon OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **3 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Lebanon ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Lebanon national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Lebanon public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Lebanon in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 3,230,000 |
| Lines / route length | 12 / 226 km |
| Fleet | 367 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $2.01 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $1.54 B (77%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 38.7 MW / 206.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $3.14 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
